algorithms.name: least-common-multiple
algorithms.body: let x=a;let y=b;let p=x*y;while(y!==0){const r=x%y;x=y;y=r;}return p/x;

algorithms.name: fibonacci-iterative
algorithms.body: let n=a;let x=0;let y=1;while(n>0){const z=x+y;x=y;y=z;n=n-1;}return x+b;

algorithms.name: prime-count-to-bound
algorithms.body: let n=a;let count=0;let x=2;while(x<=n){let prime=true;let d=2;while(d*d<=x){if(x%d===0)prime=false;d=d+1;}if(prime)count=count+1;x=x+1;}return count+b;

algorithms.name: binary-search-index
algorithms.body: let lo=0;let hi=a.length-1;let found=-1;while(lo<=hi){let mid=Math.floor((lo+hi)/2);if(a[mid]===b)found=mid;if(a[mid]<b)lo=mid+1;else hi=mid-1;}return found;
